description: Circle at the Pioneer hardware torque limit with a 40% payload mass mismatch the controllers were NOT designed for. This reproduces the FAILURE MODE the paper reports on its Pioneer hardware trial (Fig. 22: torques 'reach the saturation limits plotted (+/- 15 N.m)', Lyapunov spikes, mean positional error 1.47 m). It is a stand-in - the real Pioneer time-series the paper used is not part of this repository, so no attempt is made to reproduce its numbers.
